title: Underwriting Guide: Attaching, Changing, Suspending and Removing Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
## 1. Attachment

1.1 An option of Cardinal Rental Reimbursement can be attached only to a vehicle whose physical damage is *pending inspection* or *active*. Rental reimbursement is added only while the vehicle's physical damage is pending inspection or active. The physical damage status is read from the system record of that same vehicle's physical damage coverage.

1.2 The option's rank may be no higher than the highest rental option rank allowed by the household's auto package. A package whose highest allowed rental option rank is 0 allows no option.

1.3 The auto policy status must be *bound* or *in force* when the option is added or changed. The status is read from the system record of the policy on which the vehicle is scheduled.

## 2. Premium

2.1 The option's full-term premium is the option's six-month premium for a six-month term. For a twelve-month term it is the six-month premium multiplied by the option's twelve-month multiplier.

2.2 The premium is a flat add-on on the auto policy. It is prorated for the rest of the term when the option is added, changed or removed. On removal it is returned on the option's cancellation basis.

*Illustration (hypothetical policy):* Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 100/3000 carries a six-month premium of $46.80 and a multiplier of 2. Its full-term premium on a twelve-month policy is $46.80 multiplied by 2, which is $93.60. On a six-month policy it is $46.80.

## 3. Option changes

3.1 An option change takes effect today or on a later date the customer chooses.

3.2 A change applies only to losses on or after its effective date. A rental on a loss before the change stays under the option in force on the loss date.

*Illustration (hypothetical dates):* A customer raises 40/1200 to 75/2250 effective May 20. A loss on May 18 is rented under 40/1200, even if the rental runs after May 20. A loss on May 20 or later is rented under 75/2250.

## 4. Suspension, resumption and removal

4.1 The option is suspended while the vehicle's physical damage is in storage, and it resumes when storage ends.

4.2 The option is removed in any of these cases:
- the vehicle's physical damage is removed;
- the vehicle is removed;
- a package change lowers the highest allowed rental option rank below the option's rank and the customer does not choose a lower option.

## Conditions at a glance

| Action | Physical damage on the vehicle | Auto policy status |
|---|---|---|
| Add an option | Pending inspection or active | Bound or in force |
| Change the option | — | Bound or in force |
